/* Create the media library from the images bundled with the theme (no downloads needed). */
define( 'WP_ADMIN', true );
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/image.php';
wp_set_current_user( 1 );
$xml = simplexml_load_file( '/tmp/meteora.xml' );
$ns  = $xml->getNamespaces( true );
$dir = get_theme_file_path( 'assets/images/' );
$up  = wp_upload_dir();
foreach ( $xml->channel->item as $item ) {
	$wp = $item->children( $ns['wp'] );
	if ( 'attachment' !== (string) $wp->post_type ) {
		continue;
	}
	$url = (string) $wp->attachment_url;
	$rel = substr( $url, strpos( $url, '/assets/images/' ) + strlen( '/assets/images/' ) );
	$src = $dir . $rel;
	if ( ! file_exists( $src ) ) {
		continue;
	}
	$dest = trailingslashit( $up['path'] ) . wp_unique_filename( $up['path'], basename( $src ) );
	copy( $src, $dest );
	$id = wp_insert_attachment(
		array(
			'import_id'      => (int) $wp->post_id,
			'post_title'     => (string) $item->title,
			'post_name'      => (string) $wp->post_name,
			'post_date'      => (string) $wp->post_date,
			'post_date_gmt'  => (string) $wp->post_date_gmt,
			'post_mime_type' => 'image/webp',
			'post_status'    => 'inherit',
			'guid'           => trailingslashit( $up['url'] ) . basename( $dest ),
		),
		$dest
	);
	if ( is_wp_error( $id ) || ! $id ) {
		continue;
	}
	$meta = wp_generate_attachment_metadata( $id, $dest );
	if ( empty( $meta['width'] ) ) {
		$size = getimagesize( $dest );
		$meta = array( 'width' => $size[0] ?? 0, 'height' => $size[1] ?? 0, 'file' => _wp_relative_upload_path( $dest ) );
	}
	wp_update_attachment_metadata( $id, $meta );
	foreach ( $wp->postmeta as $pm ) {
		if ( '_wp_attachment_image_alt' === (string) $pm->meta_key ) {
			update_post_meta( $id, '_wp_attachment_image_alt', (string) $pm->meta_value );
		}
	}
}

/* Point the imported content at this Playground site, then run the theme's post-import setup. */
define( 'WP_ADMIN', true );
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
global $wpdb;
$home = untrailingslashit( get_option( 'home' ) );
$wpdb->query( $wpdb->prepare( "UPDATE {$wpdb->posts} SET post_content = REPLACE( post_content, %s, %s )", 'https://meteoraevents.com', $home ) );
if ( function_exists( 'meteora_after_import' ) ) {
	meteora_after_import();
}
foreach ( array( 'hello-world' => 'post', 'sample-page' => 'page' ) as $slug => $type ) {
	$p = get_page_by_path( $slug, OBJECT, $type );
	if ( $p ) {
		wp_delete_post( $p->ID, true );
	}
}
flush_rewrite_rules( false );
